results.description: Yuna Nishimura continued to take advantage of good scoring conditions, making nine birdies on Saturday to shoot her second consecutive 8-under 63.

results.title: Jaxon Dailey's 3 total TDs help UNI beat FCS No. 3 Illinois State 28-21
results.description: CEDAR FALLS, Iowa (AP) — Jaxon Dailey threw two touchdown passes and added a 28-yard rushing TD to help Northern Iowa beat previously-unbeaten Illinois State 28-21 on Saturday night to snap the Redbirds' 11-game road win streak.

results.title: Spain beat England 3-2 as Kane misses penalty in Nations League
results.description: Spain beat England 3-2 in the UEFA Nations League at Wembley Stadium, with Harry Kane missing a penalty after England took a 2-1 half-time lead.

results.description: MEDINAH, IL – U.S. captain Brandt Snedeker faces a dubious distinction: with his team trailing 10½‒7½ at the Presidents Cup, he could become the first losing U.S. captain since Jack Nicklaus in 1998.
